content.comment_body: Hello everyone, and congratulations on this forum. Is there any OPC Server solution available that enables a PC to connect to a [product_name] [article_no]? I'm looking for something comparable to kepserver [company_name] Suite, but specifically with support for [product_name] over TCP/IP. Thank you in advance and best regards, [user_name]

Hi, You might consider S7-200 PC-Access (an OPC server for S7-200), or Net lean (an OPC server for [product_name]). Many applications that communicate with [product_name] rely on Libnodave, which is an open-source OPC server. So Libnodave should also support communication with [product_name] [article_no]. Try searching for "[product_name] OPC" in the forum for numerous related posts, although many are in German. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are searching for an OPC server solution compatible with [product_name] [article_no] to connect to a PC via TCP/IP. There is some uncertainty about the availability of official solutions from [company_name], prompting exploration of third-party and open-source alternatives. Feedback reveals that direct support for this setup is not clearly addressed in official documentation or products.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a dependable OPC server that works smoothly with [product_name] [article_no] over TCP/IP, resembling existing solutions available for other controllers from [company_name].
